Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was backing out of a parking space at a grocery store in Conroe, Texas, when my vehicle struck the rear quarter
panel of a car that was pulling through the lane behind me. I had checked my mirrors and saw nothing, so the impact
came as a complete surprise. I stopped right away, stayed at the scene, and waited for the other driver and the police
to arrive. My head hit the steering wheel and then the window frame, and within the hour I had a throbbing headache,
nausea, and trouble focusing on the screen of my phone. A doctor later diagnosed a concussion. I have described
what happened the same way to everyone who has asked, including the officer, the adjuster, and my own physician. I
am the named driver on the policy, and I am providing this account so the claim can be processed.
